title: Our Mouths Were Filled With Laughter

request.style: English, Messianic Jewish worship, klezmer clarinet and violin, accordion, tsimbl, double bass, starting slow and wistful then breaking into a fast freylekhs dance, joyful male and female voices, 132 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion
We were like those who dream
Then our mouths were filled with laughter
And our tongues with shouts of joy

[Chorus]
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad, we are glad
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad

[Verse]
Those who sow in tears
Shall reap with shouts of joy
He who goes out weeping, bearing seed
Shall come home with shouts of joy, bringing his sheaves

[Chorus]
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad, we are glad
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad
